Sandbox_EmergencyMedicine_CauterizePain_: Pain added when cauterizing a wound (0-100).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedicine_CauterizeDamag: Extra damage the burn deals to the treated body part (0-50).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedicine_ScabDurationDa: How many days a cauterized scab stays on the body part before fading away.
Sandbox_EmergencyMedicine_ScabPainFloor_: Pain on a scabbed part never drops below this value (0 disables the floor).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedicine_RemoveScabPain: Pain added when scraping a scab off with a scalpel.
Sandbox_EmergencyMedicine_ScabScratchSev: Scratch heal time from removing a fresh scab (first quarter of its life); above 17 the panel calls it severe.
Sandbox_EmergencyMedicine_ScabScratchMod: Scratch heal time from removing a mid-age scab; above 14 the panel calls it moderate.
Sandbox_EmergencyMedicine_ScabScratchLig: Scratch heal time from removing an older scab.
Sandbox_EmergencyMedicine_ScabScratchOld: Scratch heal time from removing a scab in the last quarter of its life.
Sandbox_EmergencyMedicine_DigBulletPain_: Pain added when digging a bullet out with bare hands (0-100).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedicine_DigBulletSever: Digging always turns the wound into a deep wound; this is the extra heal time added.
Sandbox_EmergencyMedicine_DigBulletBleed: Digging causes or worsens bleeding; this is the extra bleeding time added.
Sandbox_EmergencyMedicine_DigBulletInfec: Digging always causes or worsens a local wound infection; this is the infection level bump.
Sandbox_EmergencyMedicine_CrudeStitchedD: How many days the crude stitched state stays on the part before expiring.
Sandbox_EmergencyMedicine_CrudeStitchPai: While crude stitched, every wound on the part adds this fraction of extra pain (0.2 = one fifth extra, 0 disables).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedicine_RemoveCrudeSti: Excising a crude stitch with a scalpel pushes the part's pain up to this value (default 100 = max).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedicine_CrudeStitchReo: Deep wound recovery time from excising a fresh crude stitch (first quarter); above 10 shows as severe.
Deep wound recovery time from excising a middle-aged crude stitch; above 8 shows as moderate.
Deep wound recovery time from excising an older crude stitch.
Deep wound recovery time from excising an old crude stitch (last quarter).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedicine_EmergencyFixDu: How many days the improvised fixation stays on the part; when it expires the fracture heals along with it (default 365 days).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedicine_EmergencyFixPa: While fixated, every wound on the part adds this fraction of extra pain (0.45 = nearly half again, 0 disables).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedicine_EmergencyFixWo: When the fixation is removed, the fracture scale grows by this fraction per day worn (0-1, default 0.01 = one severity point per day; 0 disables).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedicine_MorphineAddict: Addiction value added per morphine injection (0-1).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedicine_InjectionRelie: Withdrawal value removed per morphine injection (0-1).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedicine_WithdrawalClim: Game minutes for withdrawal to close the gap to the addiction baseline.
Sandbox_EmergencyMedicine_WithdrawalFall: Fraction of the above-baseline opioid withdrawal that wears off per game day (0-1).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedicine_AddictionDecay: Fraction of the opioid addiction baseline that decays per game day during severe withdrawal (0-1).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedicine_AmphWithdrawal: Game minutes for amphetamine withdrawal to close the gap to the addiction baseline (a full baseline crosses the severe threshold after half a game day).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedicine_AmphDecayRate_: Fraction of the amphetamine addiction baseline that decays per game day during severe withdrawal (0-1; much longer than opioids, default 0.36).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedicine_AmphPanicPerMi: Panic scale fraction added per game minute during amphetamine withdrawal (0-1, default 0.01 = one point per minute).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedicine_AmphUnhappines: Unhappiness scale fraction added per game minute during amphetamine withdrawal (0-1, default 0.01 = one point per minute).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedicine_AmphWithdrawal: Drug headache status progress added per game hour at severe amphetamine withdrawal or worse (0-1, on top of the status's natural decay).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedicine_AmphSleepReduc: Fatigue removed per game minute during mild and moderate amphetamine withdrawal (0-1, i.e. staying awake).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedicine_AmphHungerThir: Hunger and thirst removed per game minute while ANY amphetamine withdrawal exists, counted at least level 1 (the default outpaces the natural gains, i.e. never hungry or parched).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedicine_AmphEnduranceR: Endurance restored per game minute while ANY amphetamine withdrawal exists, counted at least level 1 (0-1; the default is tuned to survive sustained sprinting).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedicine_AmphWithdrawal: Drug fever status progress added per game hour at severe amphetamine withdrawal or worse (0-1, on top of the status's natural decay).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedicine_OpioidWithdraw: Somnolence status progress added per game hour while any opioid withdrawal exists (0-1, on top of the status's natural decay).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedicine_SomnolenceFati: FATIGUE floor at full somnolence progress (0-1); the actual floor is this x progress x the debuff conversion rate. Not applied while asleep.
Sandbox_EmergencyMedicine_AmphCrashAppet: Hunger and thirst gained per game day at severe amphetamine withdrawal or worse (default 1 = the full stat scale within one day).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedicine_CrossWithdrawa: Health scale fraction lost per game hour while opioid AND amphetamine withdrawal are both active (0-1, default 0.1 = 10% of health per hour, until death).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedicine_FentanylAddict: Addiction value added per fentanyl injection (0-1, 1.0 goes straight to the cap).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedicine_FentanylRelief: Fraction of withdrawal removed per fentanyl injection (0-1, 1.0 clears it outright).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedicine_OxycontinAddic: Addiction value added per oxycontin dose (0-1).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedicine_OxycontinRelie: Withdrawal value removed per oxycontin dose (0-1, default five doses clear it).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedicine_NaloxoneAddict: Addiction value removed per naloxone injection (0-1).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedicine_NaloxoneHunger: Hunger and thirst added per naloxone injection (0-1).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedicine_HazeMaxAlpha_t: Maximum opacity of the fullscreen withdrawal haze at full withdrawal (0-1, 0 disables the haze).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedicine_SufentanilPatc: How many days the sufentanil patch stays on the right upper arm before falling off.
Sandbox_EmergencyMedicine_SufentanilPain: Painkiller dose added per game minute while the patch is on (0-1, capped at 1).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedicine_SufentanilWith: Withdrawal value removed per game minute while the patch is on (0-1).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedicine_SufentanilAddi: Addiction value added per game minute while the patch is on (0-1).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedicine_SufentanilClea: While the patch is on, pain, panic, unhappiness and boredom are pinned at zero.
Sandbox_EmergencyMedicine_DrugStatusDose: Progress each dose adds to its drug side-effect status (0-1 of the full status). At the default, five doses reach the maximum.
Sandbox_EmergencyMedicine_DrugStatusDeca: Fraction of a drug side-effect status that wears off per in-game hour (0-1). The status ends once its progress decays to zero.
Sandbox_EmergencyMedicine_DrugStatusDebu: How strongly status progress converts into the actual debuff (0-1). 1 = full strength; 0 = the status is display-only.
Sandbox_EmergencyMedicine_MorphineSpawnW: Morphine weight in its main medical locations, e.g. hospitals (0 = never spawns). Rare spots like the police evidence room scale proportionally and empty out first at low weights.
Sandbox_EmergencyMedicine_NaloxoneSpawnW: Naloxone weight in its main medical locations, e.g. hospitals (0 = never spawns). Evidence rooms, police desks and prison cells scale proportionally.
Sandbox_EmergencyMedicine_FentanylSpawnW: Fentanyl weight in its main medical locations, e.g. hospitals (0 = never spawns). Rare spots like the police evidence room scale proportionally and empty out first at low weights.
Sandbox_EmergencyMedicine_OxycontinSpawn: Oxycontin weight in hospitals and pharmacies (0 = never spawns). The police evidence room scales proportionally.
Sandbox_EmergencyMedicine_SufentanilSpaw: Sufentanil weight in its main medical locations, e.g. hospitals (0 = never spawns). Rare spots like the police evidence room scale proportionally and empty out first at low weights.
Sandbox_EmergencyMedicine_Methamphetamin: Methamphetamine weight in the army bunker medical station (0 = never spawns). The police evidence room scales proportionally.
Sandbox_EmergencyMedicine_TranexamicAcid: Tranexamic acid weight in hospitals; pharmacies and clinics use 1.2x of it (0 = never spawns).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedicine_SulfadimidineS: Sulfadimidine weight in ranch and farm tool containers (0 = never spawns).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedicine_Dexmedetomidin: Dexmedetomidine weight in ranch and farm tool containers (0 = never spawns).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedicine_Dextromethorph: Dextromethorphan weight in pharmacy counters/shelves; bathroom cabinets use 1.25x of it (0 = never spawns).
